baseline_models.focus_anchor: The لولا construction joins كَتَبَ, ٱلْجَلَآءَ, لَعَذَّبَهُمْ, ٱلدُّنْيَا, ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ, and عَذَابُ ٱلنَّارِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A binding decree realizes forced removal in the near worldly horizon; that realized measure blocks another counterfactual worldly punishment, while the independently predicated later punishment of fire remains assigned.

activation_trace.role: Binding determination makes removal the realized measure rather than an accidental flight.
Departure from homeland supplies the concrete worldly measure governed by the decree.
Painful penalty supplies both the unrealized worldly alternative and the retained later sanction.
The nearer or first horizon locates the counterfactual penalty in worldly time.
Laterness supplies the horizon whose punishment is not cancelled by the worldly commutation.
Kindled fire gives the later punishment its explicit material destination.

changed_reading.before: They were exiled in this life and will also be punished by fire.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages a commutation: decreed exile is the realized worldly measure in place of another unrealized worldly punishment, without cancelling the assigned later fire.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The noun ٱلْجَلَآءَ is governed by كَتَبَ and carries both departure and disclosure branches of ج ل و.
baseline_models.mechanism: Forced departure remains literal while also functioning as unveiling: the decree removes a population from its covered place and thereby brings its condition into view.

activation_trace.role: Binding determination turns the disclosure into an imposed outcome rather than a merely perceptual event.
Removal from dwellings preserves the direct spatial sense of the focus noun.
Emergence after concealment overlays departure with public exposure of what had been hidden.

changed_reading.after: The imposed departure is simultaneously an exposure: removal from place makes a previously covered condition visible.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The verse contrasts فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا with فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ and counterfactual لَعَذَّبَهُمْ with possessive وَلَهُمْ ... عَذَابُ ٱلنَّارِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Nearness and laterness are not duplicate claims: the near penalty is unrealized because of the decree, whereas later fire is stated as something belonging to them.

activation_trace.role: Penalty links the horizons while their different constructions prevent simple repetition.
The near world marks the horizon of the blocked conditional penalty.
The later horizon marks the penalty asserted without a counterfactual condition.
Fire specifies what belongs to the later horizon and gives that side finality.

changed_reading.before: The verse repeats punishment once for this world and once for the next.
changed_reading.after: It constructs an asymmetric temporal ledger: one near penalty is unrealized under the decree, while a later fiery penalty is positively assigned.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prior scene moves from caused and expected exit through confidence in enclosing fortresses to ruined dwellings. This turns جلاء into unhousing: a protected interior fails, its inhabitants pass outside, and the failure of its cover becomes visible.

activation_trace.role: Removal from homeland anchors the model in the focus event.
Disclosure makes forced removal expose failed protection.
Passage outside supplies the motion crossing the formerly trusted boundary.
Preservation inside a surrounding fort supplies the enclosure whose sufficiency is disproved.
Ruination of built space makes the collapse of protection material.
Dwelling and shelter identify what removal strips away.

structural_cues: 59:2 repeats exit around the expectation that it would not occur, then moves from trusted fortresses to houses being ruined before 59:3 names decreed جلاء.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exit, enclosure, ruined dwellings, and disclosure; I supply the arrow from enclosure failure to exposed unhousing. A live alternative is that 59:2 merely narrates the event while 59:3 uses جلاء only spatially.

changed_reading.before: The decree changes the population's location.
changed_reading.after: The decree dismantles a protective inside: exile is unhousing that visibly disproves the sheltering power attributed to forts and homes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context carries material released by removal into regulated circulation, then places displaced migrants beside settled hosts who prefer others. Exile becomes the first hinge in a social topology: forced evacuation releases holdings that support movement, resettlement, and non-elite distribution elsewhere.

activation_trace.role: Binding determination anchors later material and social effects in an authorized focus measure.
Forced departure supplies the initial spatial vacancy from which redistribution is read.
Transferred property supplies the material consequence immediately downstream of removal.
The repeated property category carries transfer into an explicit distribution rule.
Movement between hands supplies the anti-concentration logic of the redistributed holdings.
Movement from one abode to another supplies a contrasting displaced population.
Being brought outside marks the migrants' loss of former homes and possessions.
Taking a settled abode supplies the receiving side of displacement and resettlement.
Choosing others over oneself supplies the host relation preventing resettlement from becoming asset capture.

structural_cues: 59:6-7 follow expulsion with transferred holdings and anti-concentration, while 59:8-9 juxtapose people driven from homes with people established in an abode who receive them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forced removal, transferred holdings, circulation, migration, settlement, and preference for others; I infer that removal releases material later routed into that social arrangement. The live alternative is that these are consecutive consequences, not part of جلاء's mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Exile ends when the expelled group leaves.
changed_reading.after: Exile initiates a material-social reconfiguration: vacated holdings enter regulated circulation while another displaced group is received and rehomed.

context_deltas.mechanism: A promise of shared exit is framed by a hidden outlet and declared false; later, outward gathering behind fortification coexists with inward dispersion. The focus جلاء discloses a coalition's actual separability: pressure turns claimed solidarity into visible fracture.

activation_trace.role: Forced departure anchors the model in the event around which alliance promises are made.
Disclosure makes departure the test revealing whether the claimed alliance is real.
A displayed entrance with a concealed exit supplies commitment that retains an escape route.
The paired forced and promised exits make shared displacement the alliance's test.
Falsity cancels the verbal appearance of solidarity and exposes divergence.
Joining what is separate supplies the coalition's visible appearance of unity.
Protection inside enclosure supplies the external architecture masking internal weakness.
Dispersion supplies the inward reality beneath the outwardly gathered formation.

structural_cues: 59:11 makes expulsion the condition of a promise to leave together and labels the speakers false; 59:14 opposes outward togetherness and fortification to scattered hearts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a false exit pledge, external gathering, enclosing defenses, and internal dispersal; I infer that exile is the stress converting concealed non-cohesion into observable separation. Alternatively, these verses may diagnose allies without redefining جلاء.

changed_reading.before: Exile visibly removes one already bounded group.
changed_reading.after: Exile is also a disclosure test: it reveals that the group and its allies were internally scattered and separable before they moved.

context_deltas.mechanism: The near-world/later-world contrast is followed by a nearby historical likeness in which consequence is tasted as harmful weight before another punishment remains. The unrealized worldly penalty gains an experiential preview through a recent analogue rather than remaining empty.

activation_trace.role: The near world supplies the first horizon whose unrealized penalty needs contextual specification.
Laterness preserves the second horizon beyond the worldly analogue.
Penalty links the focus counterfactual and later assignment to the precedent.
An exemplary case supplies a concrete pattern through which the counterfactual can be imagined.
Temporal proximity makes the precedent near enough to function as an evidentiary preview.
Experienced trial converts consequence from an abstract sentence into something undergone.
Harmful heaviness gives worldly consequence a felt material quality.
Repeated penalty preserves the two-stage structure after tasted worldly consequence.

structural_cues: 59:15 combines مِن قَبْلِهِمْ with قَرِيبًا, then coordinates tasted consequence with وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ, echoing 59:3's two horizons.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies temporal nearness, an exemplary predecessor, tasted consequence, and repeated punishment; I infer that this fills the focus counterfactual with an experiential analogue. Alternatively, 59:15 may remain a separate comparison.

changed_reading.before: The unrealized worldly punishment is an unspecified hypothetical opposite later fire.
changed_reading.after: A near precedent makes it tangible: worldly consequence can be tasted as heavy harm while remaining only the first horizon of penalty.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later context expands fire from an instrument of pain into an outcome, an abiding condition, matching recompense, and companionship. Thus عَذَابُ ٱلنَّارِ names not merely an episode of burning but an enduring destination and affiliation.

activation_trace.role: Painful penalty anchors the contextual expansion in the focus phrase.
Kindled fire supplies the material term whose duration and relational scope expand.
The end or outcome turns fire into the terminus of a causal sequence.
Repeated fire identifies the focus destination with the contextual outcome.
Persistent abiding supplies duration beyond a momentary punitive event.
Corresponding recompense links prior action to enduring outcome.
Companionship and inseparable association recast fire as durable belonging.
Repeated fire is the object around which the social designation forms.

structural_cues: 59:17 makes fire the outcome, adds remaining in it, and calls it recompense; 59:20 then names companions of fire against companions of the garden.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies outcome, fire, abiding, recompense, and companionship; I infer these expand the focus punishment of fire. Alternatively, companionship may be conventional group labeling with no added spatial content.

changed_reading.before: The later punishment is an inflicted fiery episode.
changed_reading.after: The later punishment is an enduring condition and destination: fire becomes outcome, recompense, and defining companionship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus separates near and later horizons, while 59:18 depicts a self sending something forward for tomorrow. This bridges them: what is done in the near horizon can be pre-positioned as content encountered in the later one.

activation_trace.role: The near world supplies the horizon from which action is sent forward.
Laterness supplies the horizon in which what was advanced is encountered.
Advancing something ahead supplies directional transfer from present action toward result.
Tomorrow supplies a compressed image of the later horizon as an approaching encounter.

structural_cues: 59:18 places مَّا قَدَّمَتْ immediately before لِغَدٍ, giving future consequence a directional relation to present conduct.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies near/later horizons and advancing something for tomorrow; I infer that the later assignment in 59:3 can be content prepared across time, not only imposed externally. Alternatively, 59:18 may be a general exhortation not projected onto 59:3.

changed_reading.before: The near and later penalties are externally ordered times with no stated bridge.
changed_reading.after: The later horizon can receive what present action sent ahead; temporal separation becomes a directional consequence mechanism.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pairing of concealed and witnessed domains supplies an epistemic axis for the disclosure branch of جلاء. Forced removal transfers a concealed condition into the witnessed field under the knowledge of the decreeing agent.

activation_trace.role: Emergence from concealment anchors the epistemic reading in the focus noun.
Actual departure keeps epistemic transfer attached to literal displacement.
Concealment from sight supplies the starting pole of disclosure.
Presence with witnessing supplies the visible pole into which the condition emerges.

structural_cues: 59:22 places ٱلْغَيْبِ and ٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ in a balanced pair under divine knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, witnessed presence, and disclosure; I infer movement from one epistemic pole to the other through literal removal. Alternatively, 59:22 may describe divine knowledge without commenting on the exile.

changed_reading.before: Exile exposes failed defenses to observers in the historical scene.
changed_reading.after: Exile moves a concealed condition into the witnessed domain, making disclosure an epistemic dimension of displacement.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus forms of ع ذ ب ordinarily denote punishment and the worldly verb is counterfactual, not a gloss of exile. It remains anchored through withholding and sky-exposure branches of that focus root, literal removal, and contextual destruction of dwellings. Render it as a material resonance describing how exile can hurt, not as a replacement translation of لَعَذَّبَهُمْ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The realized ٱلْجَلَآءَ stands beside unrealized worldly لَعَذَّبَهُمْ, whose inventory includes withholding and exposure without cover.

activation_trace.role: Removal from homeland supplies the actual condition whose punitive material effects are explored.
Withholding and deprivation supply a non-inflictive way removal can become painful.
Exposure without covering supplies the roofless edge of forced departure.
Ruined built space makes deprivation of cover concrete.
Shelter and dwelling identify the protection withheld by unhousing.

changed_reading.before: Exile and punishment are wholly separate alternatives.
changed_reading.after: Without collapsing their grammar, unrealized عذاب shadows realized exile: unhousing can hurt through deprivation and exposure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain analogy is surprising because a decree of exile is not the descending Qur'an and the expelled community is not the mountain. It remains anchored in the writing and binding branches of ك ت ب and disclosure in ج ل و, while 59:21 supplies delivered recitation, solidity, submission, and fracture. Render it only as an image of mechanism, not an identification of actors or events.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ ... ٱلْجَلَآءَ permits writing or binding determination to meet disclosure in one imposed event.

activation_trace.role: Inscribed language supplies the textual edge of the focus decree.
Binding determination keeps the textual image attached to an effective outcome.
Disclosure supplies visible emergence produced by the effective word.
Delivery downward supplies directional arrival of a word upon a resistant object.
Recitation supplies effective verbal content in the analogy.
Elevated solidity supplies the seemingly resistant form acted upon.
Lowering and submission supply the first transformation under pressure.
A fissure in something solid supplies the image for a hardened order becoming divided.

changed_reading.before: The decree is an administrative cause and exile its spatial result.
changed_reading.after: As a contained image, an effective word bears on apparent solidity until it lowers and fractures; exile visibly discloses that break.

strongest_changes: جلاء became both unhousing and disclosure of failed enclosure, not mere relocation.
Expulsion opened into transferred holdings, circulation, migration, and resettlement.
Coalition language made exile a stress test exposing fragmentation beneath fortification and claimed unity.
Punishment of fire expanded from an episode into enduring outcome, recompense, and companionship.
summary.what_was_special: The focus verse is hinge-like: its counterfactual commutes one worldly measure for another, while ج ل و links evacuation to disclosure and the context traces the event into property, coalition, temporal, and final-state mechanisms.
remaining_uncertainties: Disclosure in ج ل و may function only as resonance beside direct exile.
The arrow from vacated holdings to the full resettlement ethic is partly reader-supplied.
Deprivation and mountain-fracture readings require explicit exploratory qualification.
